sentences.en: In 2005, anyone lusting for Jessica Alba bikini pictures received a bonanza when she starred in the film Into the Blue, in which she played a diver and wore almost nothing except bikinis through the entire film.

sentences.en: The iPod Nano and iPod Shuffle are hot among younger kids, while older and more responsible teens are lusting after new releases like the fifth generation iPod video.
